sub_sector.value: Defaulted debt purchasing and recovery; credit servicing

financial_business_type.detail: Specialty finance company that buys defaulted receivables and provides debt servicing and portfolio management.

revenue_driver.detail: Returns from collections on purchased receivables, plus fees for debt servicing and portfolio management.

customer_type.detail: Consumers repaying debts, plus banks, credit unions, consumer finance companies, retailers and utilities that sell or outsource receivables.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Deploys its own capital to buy defaulted receivables and bears collection risk. Also services accounts for credit originators.
